messages.text:
"Create a creature collector with 4 main cities, there should be different routes between the cities packed with areas to battle and capture creatures. Creatures should be designed based on real life animals and insects, as well as mythological creatures. They should have variations based on elemental affinity. Elements should include Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Electric, Poison, Ice. The game should include a battling system and a capturing system. Each creature should have stats for Health, Attack, Defence, and Special, with the Special stat being their ability to resist other element types. Creatures should have 2-3 evolutions, with their first evolutiom giving a 10% bonus increase to all stats, and the second and third evolutions giving 20% and 30% bonus. There needs to be items to recover the health of the creatures. The creatures will be called Cranos(plural) or Crano(singular). The game shall be called Cranomolis.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
